-Agent harnesses — the external systems that mediate model–environment interaction — can substantially improve agent performance, but their gains remain tied to the harness at deployment. **Harness-Zero** transfers the behaviors an optimized harness induces into the model itself: a *harnessing agent* reviews the student's every response during training-time rollouts and rewrites it, in the student's own action space, whenever the optimized harness would have done better.
